incidents.summary: Media investigations reported that AJ Bell allowed tax-ineligible stocks in ISAs, with the option to add TSMC subsequently removed but Criteo still available.

sources.title: Exclusive: Investment platforms flouting tax rules on ISA stocks
sources.quote: A Bloomberg investigation recently found TSMC could be added to ISA on AJ Bell and Fidelity, but this option was quickly removed following the revelations.

sources.title: Exclusive: Investment platforms flouting tax rules on ISA stocks
sources.quote: Meanwhile, AJ Bell allows French advertising company Criteo to be added to an ISA, which is also not eligible for the tax perk.

incidents.summary: The Pensions Ombudsman found that AJ Bell's software caused an error calculating elements of a client's pension funds, but AJ Bell avoided a compensation order.

sources.title: Software blamed for Sipp problems at AJ Bell - FTAdviser
sources.quote: AJ Bell has avoided a compensation order from the Pensions Ombudsman after it found the provider’s software was to blame for an error which occurred when calculating certain elements of a client's pension funds.
